title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-17
lineage: SBD > Reel Master (10 Inch Reels @ 15ips 1/2trk) > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard capture of a rare early‑66 set, highlighted by the one‑off In The Pines, Cream Puff War and a muscular King Bee.
ai_review.review: The SBD source delivers surprisingly clear audio for a 1966 recording, letting listeners hear Jerry’s snarling guitar tone and Billy’s thumping drums.  The short but potent set is filled with early‑Dead fire—standout performances of Cream Puff War, King Bee, Cold Rain & Snow and the unique In The Pines make it a prized document despite a few missing songs.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both the musical performance (high energy, rare tracks) and the soundboard quality; only isolated complaints about missing songs lower the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early SBD is described as crisp and clear for its era, with excellent balance that captures the band’s dynamics; some reviewers note the recording is incomplete (missing a few songs) but audio fidelity is praised.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A short, early‑summer Fillmore set that flows tightly despite its brevity; strong first‑set work leads into a punchy second set with extended jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as having a snarling, "horny" guitar tone and delivering muscular lead work throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted as absent on Cream Puff War in one review; otherwise no specific comments.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy's drumming on Cold Rain & Snow is praised as already great; overall drum work described as thumping and driving the early psychedelic feel.
